faq.question: Q1. What is the conducting organization for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by Regional Cancer Centre, Thiruvananthapuram (RCC Thiruvananthapuram) for filling up research positions in Kerala.

faq.question: Q2. What is the name of the post advertised?
faq.answer: The post advertised is Statistician under project recruitment category for qualified professionals with statistical background.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the Statistician post under this recruitment notification.

faq.question: Q4. What is the mode of application?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted through offline mode by sending the filled application form and bio-data via post.

faq.question: Q5. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The last date for the receipt of completed offline applications at the designated address is 07-10-2026.

faq.question: Q6. What is the essential educational qualification required?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Post Graduate degree in Statistics along with relevant experience in data analysis using SPSS, R, or Python.

faq.question: Q7. What is the age limit for applicants?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for applicants applying for the Statistician post is 35 years as per the notification guidelines.

faq.question: Q8. What is the salary offered for this position?
faq.answer: Selected candidates appointed for the Statistician post on a contract basis will receive a consolidated monthly salary of Rs.32,000/-.

faq.question: Q9. Where should the application form be sent?
faq.answer: The application and bio-data duly signed and addressed to the Director, Regional Cancer Centre, Thiruvananthapuram should be sent to the Finance Manager (Projects).

faq.question: Q10. Is there any application fee required?
faq.answer: No application fee is mentioned in the official notification for submitting the offline application form.
